probability_model.random_variable: scene_positive under the exact two-trajectory primary roster
assumptions: exchangeable Bernoulli scene-positive indicators from the frozen target sampling frame
no scene replacement or informative deletion
all endpoint and reference evidence complete; otherwise the gate blocks
two registered trajectories and exactly one primary source-target unit per trajectory
probability_model.if_assumptions_fail: no population p-value or prevalence claim; report roster-specific descriptive results only

v3_n8_audit.rule: success when at least 5 of 8 scenes are positive
v3_n8_audit.interpretation: fewer than 5 positives cannot establish absence; it can be a low-power no-go

stage_1.reason_no_early_efficacy: preserve a fixed N=20 confirmatory endpoint and avoid selective secondary inference

v4_two_stage_design.error_control: the final composite gate is a subset of the calibrated count gate, so its one-sided type-I error is no greater than 0.029978782278531154 under the stated model
v4_two_stage_design.power_boundary: 0.850114822387695312 is an upper bound until the joint scene-rate distribution is justified; under the exact V4 two-unit roster, positive rates are at least 0.5 and the mean/LOSO conditions follow from count>=8, making the bound exact
v4_two_stage_design.no_stage_d_adaptation: Stage D may test hooks and estimate runtime only; it cannot change n, boundaries, endpoints, seed roster, source selector, reference rule or sampling frame

compound_gate_proof_for_exact_v4_roster.scene_positive_threshold: 1/5, operationally at least one of two units
compound_gate_proof_for_exact_v4_roster.count_implication: 8 positive scenes imply total rate mass >= 8*(1/2)=4, hence mean >=4/20=1/5
compound_gate_proof_for_exact_v4_roster.loso_implication: removing any one scene removes at most 1, leaving mass >=3 and LOSO mean >=3/19 >3/20
compound_gate_proof_for_exact_v4_roster.guard_against_future_drift: the reference code still evaluates count, mean and LOSO separately; changing units per scene requires a new version and new power analysis

threshold_sensitivity_policy.rule: alternative thresholds may be reported as labelled sensitivity only and can never replace the primary boundary
